note: Passages only, of a 10,459-word report. The report states that the ministry continued putting in place a unified national health information system in 2021 without saying what it does, so it is unclassified and gives no fact. It reports technical difficulties with the information system from the delayed RNS NG network modernisation contract: an enabling system, no fact. The passages give no tier, coverage or point-of-entry statement for the medical record, and nothing on routine aggregate reporting, so no hmis fact.
